name: vertex_pack
describe: Pack one quad (int[28], DefaultVertexFormats.BLOCK = 7 ints/vertex) into the int buffer, overwrite the lightmap UV ints (putBrightness4 -> ints 6,13,20,27), then apply per-vertex color multiplier (putColorMultiplier vertexIndex 4,3,2,1 -> color ints 3,10,17,24, little-endian branch). Bit-exact: int writes + (int)(float*float) channel truncation.
